title: IELTS Academic Unit 01 — Education: Practice Set

items.prompt: What is the main idea of the passage?

options.text: Universities should replace traditional examinations with digital learning.
Education is changing from a mainly knowledge-transfer model towards a broader and more flexible role.
Online education is more effective than classroom education.
Vocational education is becoming more important than university education.

items.explanation: The passage discusses several changes in education, including access, skills, technology, assessment and lifelong learning. It does not argue that one particular method should replace all others.

items.prompt: According to paragraph 2, what has happened to participation in higher education?

options.text: It has become restricted to students with exceptional academic results.
It has expanded to include a wider range of learners.
It has been replaced by vocational training.

items.explanation: The passage states that participation in higher education has expanded and that a wider range of learners now seek university qualifications.

items.prompt: Why does the passage say that a qualification may not be enough for employers?

options.text: Employers may also require communication, problem-solving and independent-working skills.
Universities no longer teach practical subjects.
Employers prefer vocational qualifications in every situation.

items.explanation: Paragraph 3 states that organisations may expect graduates to communicate, solve problems and work independently in addition to holding a qualification.

items.prompt: What limitation of digital learning is mentioned?

options.text: Digital resources are unavailable to most learners.
Digital technology alone does not guarantee better learning outcomes.
Online courses are only useful for university students.

items.explanation: The passage explicitly states that digital learning does not automatically produce better educational outcomes.

items.prompt: What does the final paragraph suggest about the future of education?

options.text: Education will probably combine established practices with newer approaches.
Students will become entirely responsible for their own education.

items.explanation: The final paragraph argues for a combination of established educational practices and new approaches.

items.prompt: Higher education was historically available to a relatively small proportion of the population.
Most employers consider university qualifications more important than practical skills.
items.explanation: The passage says employers may expect graduates to communicate, solve problems and work independently, but it does not compare the relative importance of qualifications and practical skills.

items.prompt: Digital learning automatically produces better educational outcomes.
items.explanation: The passage explicitly states that digital learning does not automatically produce better educational outcomes.

items.prompt: Projects and presentations can provide information that a single examination may not reveal.
items.explanation: This is stated directly in paragraph 5.

items.prompt: The passage claims that lifelong learning should become compulsory for all workers.
items.explanation: The passage explains why lifelong learning is increasingly important but does not state that it should be compulsory.

items.prompt: In paragraph 1, what does “conventional” most nearly mean?
items.explanation: “Conventional classroom” refers to the established or traditional classroom model described immediately afterwards.

items.prompt: In paragraph 3, what does “accumulation” most nearly mean?
items.explanation: “Accumulation of information” means gradually collecting information.

items.prompt: In paragraph 4, what does “flexibility” refer to?

options.text: The ability to change a university's curriculum every year
The ability to study without any instruction
The ability to fit learning around different circumstances

items.explanation: The paragraph connects flexibility with people who work, live far away or have other responsibilities.

items.prompt: In paragraph 5, what does “reveal” most nearly mean?
items.explanation: An examination may fail to “reveal” certain information, meaning it may fail to show it.

items.prompt: In the final paragraph, what does “established educational practices” most nearly refer to?

options.text: Methods that have already been accepted and used in education

items.explanation: “Established” means already accepted or recognised; the phrase contrasts established practices with newer approaches.
